name: Zoho PageSense for WordPress
author: pagesense

sections.description:
Zoho PageSense aims to boost user experience and website performance through web analytics and optimization. To optimize website elements like content, layout, and design, it is used to analyze visitor behavior, carry out A/B testing, and gain deeper user insights. To increase engagement, improve conversion rates, and ultimately enhance the overall efficacy of their online presence, PageSense facilitates organizations in making data-driven decisions.

POLLS, POP-UPS, AND PUSH NOTIFICATIONS

Boost website traffic by keeping your users engaged via Pop-Ups, Push Notifications, and Polls. Forms to get your visitors to sign up through your landing page. Trigger contextual pop-ups at the right place and time to convince your visitors to make a decision before they exit your page.

MEASURE, OPTIMIZE, AND IMPROVE

Use Zoho PageSense’s inbuilt CRO tools to measure how your pages perform. Run extensive A/B tests on forms, content, CTA buttons, and layouts to study which design works best.
Personalize your pages to fit different groups of demographics and improve conversion rates instantly by offering what is relevant to each target group.
Use advanced Form Analytics to understand where your potential leads drop off and take corrective measures to improve conversions.

Configuring your Zoho PageSense for WordPress

Here’s a step-by-step guide that will help you to configure Zoho PageSense for WordPress:
1. Login to your Zoho PageSense account. If you don’t have an account yet, sign up by following this link and get your free trial now.
2. Login to your WordPress account as an admin.
3. Click Plugins and then Add New.
4. Search for Zoho PageSense for WordPress and Install the plugin.
5. Activate the installed plugin.
6. Open the Zoho PageSense plugin in WordPress and enter your client ID and Client Secret. To get your client ID and Client Secret, follow the steps given below:
a. Open https://api-console.zoho.com.
b. Click Get Started and then click Server-based Applications.
c. Create a new client by entering the Client Name, Homepage URL, and Redirect URLs.
d. You will find the Client ID and Client Secret once you complete this step.
9. Once you enter the Client ID and Client Secret, select your Zoho PageSense Space and Project.
10. If you want to directly integrate your page with WordPress, click on Connect. If you use certain WordPress themes and if you want to insert PageSense script manually, click on Get your Code.
Info: Copy and paste the code snippet into the tag of your website to track visitors and collect feedback. For more help, refer to our online documentation or write to us at support@zohopagesense.com.
sections.installation:
You can install the Zoho PageSense plugin two ways:
* Under the Plugins section of your WordPress Dashboard, search for Zoho PageSense for WordPress.
* Install via the built-in WordPress plugin installer.
